description: Dapp capsule → broker provider bridge. Grants the capsule webview exactly one IPC command (provider_msg, the zero-authority EIP-1193 forwarder — same entry point and label-keyed authorization as the clbridge route), including from remote web origins: real dapps are https pages whose CSP/mixed-content rules block fetch() to custom schemes, so the bridge must ride Tauri's native IPC channel. The command re-checks the webview label host-side; broker authority is unchanged (display + forward only, the wallet decides).
